live.transcriptDescription: Local and remote sources, timestamps, and interim results are shown separately.
live.questionOne: Why does the first stage build meeting records before Meeting Copilot?
live.answerOne: Audio, speakers, and the timeline are the factual foundation. Copilot can consume those facts but cannot control the recording lifecycle.
live.questionTwo: If Copilot times out, do recording and live transcription fail too?
live.answerTwo: No. The four states are independent. A Copilot failure stays in the right panel while recording continues writing recovery checkpoints.
live.copilotDescription: Provides suggestions only and never speaks or sends content to meeting software.
live.question: Does a Copilot timeout affect recording and live transcription?
live.listening: Listening now; understanding starts automatically after the utterance completes
live.understandingContext: Understanding context and preparing a suggestion…
live.answerSummary: No. Meeting Copilot is isolated from the recording pipeline.
live.pointOne: Recording keeps writing local recovery checkpoints.
live.pointTwo: A transcription failure does not stop the original audio.
live.pointThree: A Copilot timeout affects only the current suggestion.
